title: Test spec file reading
prompt:
This is a test task to verify spec reading in the collaboration framework. Your task:

1. Read the file `openspec/README.md` if it exists, or any `.md` file in the openspec directory
2. Create a summary file at `.worktrees/test-spec-reading/spec-summary.txt` containing:
   - The name of the spec file you read
   - First 100 characters of its content
   - Confirmation that spec reading works

This verifies that workers can access and read specification files.
